rules.text: OTT, Social, FAST, Other platform, and Download outputs each take exactly one input; if two sources need to reach one of these, give each source its own output, or put a Switcher in front of a single shared destination.
When a live event and a linear channel both need to go to OTT, give each one its own OTT output rather than feeding one OTT output from both.
Live events, channels, and Uplynk asset outputs are always fed by a Uplynk Transcode or Uplynk Repackaging step, never straight from ingest.
ABR signals (HLS, DASH) go into Cloud Ingest (ABR) and then Uplynk Repackaging; SDI, SRT, RTMP, RIST, Zixi, 2110 signals and files go into Cloud Ingest (Slicer) and then Uplynk Transcode.
SCTE-35 ad markers work on Cloud Ingest (Slicer), not on ABR signals or Cloud Ingest (ABR).
To feed one social or FAST destination from several sources, put a Switcher in front of it.
A Linear Channel is Live by default; use Scheduled only when the operator wants to schedule or mix live with VOD or other live content.
